description.narrative: The objective of the GEF PPG is to develop the Blue-Green Atolls concept (PIF) into a full UNDP/GEF project: Blue-Green Atolls: Addressing Land Degradation, Groundwater Salinization & Coastal Erosion in RMI via climate-resilient strategies for the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). The project aims to strengthen climate resilience and prevent land degradation by combining climate-smart water management with ecosystem and land restoration using EbA/NbS and organic waste-to-compost approaches. As described in the PIF, this project aims to enhance climate resilience and halt land degradation across RMI’s atolls through integrated, climate-smart water management and ecosystem restoration (EbA/NbS and organic-waste-to-compost) that safeguard freshwater lenses, soils, and coasts, while strengthening the enabling environment by addressing fragmented governance, limited capacity, and constrained financing.
